system.name: Coyote v2
system.one_liner: an open-source, three-layer hierarchical FPGA shell supporting dynamic partial reconfiguration and multi-tenancy for data-center FPGAs

components.name: TLB
components.role: address translation for the application-layer vFPGA

components.name: vFPGA
components.role: traffic sniffer application logic built on Coyote v2, exposes control registers to the host

components.name: Control-Unit
components.role: configures the filter selection from host software via axi_ctrl

components.name: Stream Merger & Mem. Access
components.role: merges RX/TX streams, handles memory access, and forwards data via host_send

components.name: 100G Network Stack
components.role: Coyote v2 shell service providing RoCE v2 and TCP/IP network stacks

components.name: Filter
components.role: network filter inserted between the network stacks and the 100G CMAC, filters RX/TX traffic based on user configuration

components.name: HBM
components.role: on-card memory accessible from the dynamic layer

summary: Coyote v2 is an open-source, dynamically reconfigurable FPGA shell for data-center use. Figure 6 is a case-study diagram of a traffic sniffer application built on Coyote v2: in the Application Layer, a vFPGA (Traffic Sniffer) contains a Control-Unit, configured via the host-facing axi_ctrl interface, and a Stream Merger & Mem. Access block that outputs to host_send and reads/writes HBM. A dashed vertical line separates this from the Dynamic Layer, where Coyote v2's shared 100G Network Stack (RoCE v2 and TCP/IP) is intercepted by a Filter; the Control-Unit sends a Filter Selection signal to configure it, and red/green lines trace RX and TX traffic through the filter into and out of the Stream Merger. The figure illustrates how a user application taps into a shell-provided, dynamically reconfigured network service without reimplementing it.
summary_zh: 图6为Coyote v2案例研究：应用层的vFPGA流量嗅探器通过控制单元配置动态层100G网络栈中插入的Filter，红/绿线分别表示RX/TX流量路径，体现应用复用共享服务的设计。
